extracted.name: Shrimp Ramakie
extracted.description: A family friend brought this over when visiting us one get together. Her version included water chestnuts. So this is my revised version of what she called shrimp ramakie.
ingredient_lines: Bacon (1 package) approximately 15 slices cut in half. total about 30 pieces
2 tbsp (divided) Cavender’s All Purpose Greek Seasoning
instruction_lines: Soak shrimp in lemon juice and water for 15 minutes.
Lay out bacon slices and sprinkle each with sugar and Cavender’s seasoning.
Place a shrimp on each bacon slice, roll up, and secure with a toothpick.
Sprinkle more Cavender’s seasoning over the rolled shrimp.
Cook on a preheated Blackstone griddle until bacon is crisp and shrimp are cooked through. Or...
Air Fryer Bacon-Wrapped Shrimp by placing the shrimp on an air fryer tray.
Open the air fryer, flip each shrimp, and cook for another 4-5 minutes.
The shrimp is ready when the bacon is crispy and the shrimp are pink and opaque.
